Welcome! One-time setup:

1. Scan the code on the right with your phone (on the same Wi-Fi as the TV).
2. On the page that opens, enter your phone number, then the login code Telegram sends you.

The TV does the rest.
✔ Code sent. Enter it on your phone (Telegram chat “Telegram”).
Getting your API keys from Telegram…

Welcome! One-time setup:

1. On your phone, open my.telegram.org (scan the code on the right), log in with your phone number, then API development tools → create an app (any name).
2. Enter the App api_id and api_hash on the right, then Save and start.

Tip: select a field and type with the Google TV / Android TV remote app on your phone.
Telegram — in the Telegram app:\nSettings → Devices → Link Desktop Device
Stremio — scan with the phone camera, then confirm
